name: Your Name
intro: I edit reels, brand films and YouTube videos, and I make visuals with AI tools. This page is a running reel of what I've made lately.
bio: I started editing on a borrowed laptop, cutting videos for friends, and never stopped. Today I work with creators, small brands and agencies on everything from 15-second reels to full launch films.
Lately I've been mixing traditional editing with AI tools: generated scenes, voice work and upscaling, always finished by hand so the result still feels made by a person.
